title: Code and data for: Oxygen dictates the spatial reach of nitric oxide through coupled synthesis and catalytic degradation
description: Model, simulation code and simulation outputs behind every figure of the paper: coupled oxygen and nitric oxide transport with oxygen-dependent NO synthesis by the three NOS isoforms and a measured two-route cellular NO sink, solved in perivascular, tissue, vessel, spherical-tumor and vascularized-tumor geometries.
